candidates.description: A standardized scale used to assess a patient's functional status and ability to perform activities of daily living.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric ECOG score mentioned in the performance status or assessment section.
candidates.measurement_definition: Numeric score from 0 (fully active) to 5 (dead), typically documented in the Performance Status or Assessment sections.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: While numeric values are provided, the specific clinical criteria used to assign the score (e.g., whether 'ECOG 2' is based on a specific assessment tool) are not detailed.

citations.quote: role of immunotherapy (PD‑1/PD‑L1 inhibitors) given PD‑L1 TPS 10%

candidates.description: The percentage of viable tumor cells showing partial or complete membrane staining for PD-L1, used to guide immunotherapy selection.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical percentage associated with 'PD-L1 TPS' or 'PD-L1 expression' from the molecular profile section.
candidates.measurement_definition: A percentage value representing the proportion of tumor cells expressing PD-L1.
candidates.name: PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS)
candidates.uncertainty: The specific assay or staining protocol used to determine the TPS is not mentioned.

limitations: Limited number of unique patients provided in the excerpts.
PD-L1 expression is reported as a percentage in some cases but only qualitatively in others.
summary: The evidence identifies functional status (ECOG) and biomarker expression (PD-L1 TPS) as key baseline clinical variables used to differentiate treatment strategies (e.g., single-agent vs. combination therapy) in patients with KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC.
